name: oido-shopify
description: Manage a Shopify store — products, orders, customers and inventory — via MCP, using the Admin GraphQL API and a custom-app access token.

settings.name: SHOPIFY_STORE
settings.description: Store domain, e.g. acme.myshopify.com (the permanent myshopify.com domain, not a custom domain)

settings.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
settings.description: Admin API access token (shpat_…) from a custom app in Shopify admin

settings.name: SHOPIFY_API_VERSION
settings.description: Admin API version, e.g. 2026-07. Leave empty for the plugin default.
